# Scenario Clarification

## Backend

- **Target framework**: Java 26 (GraalVM 26 EA) CLI application with Micronaut 5 DI; single Maven module preserved
- **API contract preservation**: Not applicable to external HTTP/RPC APIs; project has no frontend, UI, database, or API server. CLI option names and `application.yml` keys may break only when justified by architecture quality, with ADR and migration notes.
- **Data migration strategy**: No migration — the project has no database or persistent application data store.
- **Auth framework**: Preserve existing external GitHub authentication flow through GitHub CLI / GitHub Copilot CLI integration (`gh auth`, `gh copilot`).
- **SLA targets**: match current production baseline; no regression — (default)

## Generic

- **Success definition**: Rebuild `src/main/java/dev/logicojp/reviewer` in place as a clear Ports & Adapters layered architecture: `presentation` / `application` including `application.port` / purified `domain` / `infrastructure` / `shared`; dependencies point inward only; zero package cycles; domain imports only `java.*` and domain types; external SDK, Micronaut, Jakarta, SLF4J, and SnakeYAML dependencies are isolated outside domain; boundaries are enforced by ArchUnit tests; existing Maven shade, GraalVM native image, Micronaut AOT, and CI-relevant build behavior are preserved.
- **Out of scope**: Frontend/UI work, database/data migration, service extraction, dependency/runtime version upgrades, multi-module Maven, JPMS `module-info`, gratuitous CLI/config breaking changes, and changes outside the in-place target unless required for tests/docs/ADR/migration notes.
- **Existing test posture**: must pass — (default)
